title: Sr Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
  
  
The Sr. Support Engineer (I.C.) provides advanced technical support to customers using Gigamon solutions. This role troubleshoots complex networking issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, manages escalations through resolution, and partners with internal teams to address customer concerns. The engineer also supports RMA coordination, issue documentation, and customer satisfaction analysis. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, effective cross-functional collaboration, and a customer-focused approach to problem resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide advanced technical support to assigned customers through phone and email support queues.
* Troubleshoot, reproduce, and develop workarounds for complex product and networking issues.
* Apply strong knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, OSPF, Layer 2 and Layer 3 VPNs, multicast protocols, VLANs, trunks, switching, stacking, and service provider technologies.
* Troubleshoot GTP correlation issues and use network test equipment, including Spirent and IXIA.
* Manage hot escalations and drive customer issues through resolution while maintaining clear communication with all involved parties.
* Document and report the status of major issues, operational conditions, customer concerns, and resolution activities.
* Coordinate RMA processes, including equipment delivery to customers and the return of hardware from customer locations to Gigamon.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Sustaining Engineering, and other internal organizations to communicate customer requirements and advocate for timely resolutions.
* Analyze and report on customer satisfaction related to Gigamon products, services, and processes.
* Participate in customer support center activities and contribute to consistent, high-quality support operations.

**What You’ve Done**

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Gained at least four years of technical service or technical support experience in networking.
* Built strong working knowledge across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting customer issues, reproducing problems, and developing effective workarounds.
* Managed technical escalations and coordinated complex issues across multiple internal teams.
* Worked directly with customers to resolve technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Developed strong project management, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated the ability to document, analyze, and report on technical issues and customer feedback.

**Who You Are**

* A customer-focused technical professional who advocates for timely and effective resolutions.
* An empowered self-starter who works effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* A clear and confident communicator with strong verbal, written, and presentation skills in English.
* An active listener who builds productive relationships with customers and cross-functional teams.
* An organized professional who can prioritize responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* A collaborative partner who takes initiative, adapts to changing priorities, and works with limited supervision.

As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. For more information, please refer to Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for all qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at (669) 240-2248.
  
  
If your experience and skills closely match our job description but may not necessarily fulfill all requirements, please still apply. Gigamon is on a continued mission to grow and scale an innovative organization. We believe this is best achieved by hiring, celebrating, and respecting people with diverse backgrounds, skills, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
The privacy rights of all individuals including job applicants and candidates are very important to us. Our Gigamon Applicant Privacy Policy, will inform you about how Gigamon Inc. and its direct and indirect subsidiaries collect, use, store, or otherwise process personal information about job applicants and candidates, including through your access and/or use of our careers website and third-party job websites (e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Naukri, etc.).
  
  
We may use automated tools, including AI-based systems, to help screen and evaluate application materials for this role. These tools are designed to assess job-related qualifications only and do not make final hiring decisions; human reviewers remain involved in the process. Further, Gigamon uses Jobvite, developed by Employ, to screen and evaluate all Gigamon applicant resumes. The system analyzes resumes for skills, experience, and qualifications and processes employment history, education, and skills. This AI-based system is used for all Gigamon positions. For questions, contact [email protected]. You have the right to request reasonable accommodation; to do so, please send a message to [email protected].

title: MS Engineer OSS
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled OSS Expert with strong experience in GDC NOC Operations, Linux administration, OpenShift, and Kubernetes environments. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in Nokia Cloud Platform (NCP), Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (NCOM), and NetAct/NSP/OSS products, including Fault, Configuration, and Problem Management within Enterprise Networks (Private Wireless LTE). Strong knowledge of Git & GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and production support is essential. The role also requires experience working across multi-domain network elements, ensuring system stability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable efficient cloud operations and seamless service delivery.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Resolution & providing technical support for the incidents reported/request Cloud products, including Nokia Cloud Platform (NCP), Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (NCOM), OSS Products (Analysis, Troubleshooting & fixing the issues reported).
* Manages technical escalations for technical requests, emergency cases and outages internally and towards customers.
* Strong hands-on experience with Linux administration, including user management, file system management, process monitoring, and system troubleshooting.
* Good knowledge of Linux shell scripting, package management, service configuration, and performance monitoring in production environments.
* Strong experience in Git & GitHub for source code management, branching strategies, and collaborative development workflows.
* Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes for container orchestration, application deployments, scaling, and monitoring.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release management processes.
* Experience in managing and deploying applications on OpenShift platforms.
* Proficient in troubleshooting deployment issues and maintaining high availability environments.
* Ability to work closely with development and infrastructure teams for seamless delivery and operations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders like GDC, Care, Field, 3 rd PP & Customer to resolve the issues.
* Participate in CAB/CR meetings. Preparing & Validating the MoPs and executing the CRs with 100% FTR.
* Design, deploy, configure, and integrate cloud solutions independently, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
* Manage deployments and upgrades for existing customers, focusing on “right first time” execution and quick issue resolution.
* Oversee New Product Introductions (NPI) for global rollouts, driving innovation and integrating cross-product solutions.
* Provide maintenance support and operations, including defect analysis, troubleshooting, and incident resolution.
* Create and update comprehensive project documentation, including MOPs, reports, and incident RCAs.
* Ensure robust configuration management by performing regular backups, optimizing backup routines, and maintaining accurate version control across hardware and software assets.

**Key Skills And Experience**
You have:
  
  

* Require any bachelor’s degree with related field.
* Typically, a minimum 5 to 10 years of telecom experience, with 5+ years in Cloud & OSS solutions.
* Proven expertise in OCP Platform Administration and Kubernetes management.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and automation technologies (e.g., Ansible, Helm).
* Good IP networking background and scripting capabilities (Shell, PERL, Python).
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration.
* L3 Certified Specialist on Open Shift & NCP, MantaRay.
* Skilled in Linux administration across multiple distributions (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Ubuntu) and proficient in private cloud platforms such as OpenStack, VMware, Kubernetes, Nokia CBIS/NCS, RH OpenShift, NCP, and VMware Tanzu.
* Proficient in scripting and automation using Linux shell, Python, and Perl for efficient operations and process optimization.

It would be nice if you also had:
  
  

* Strong background in Networking, VNF and CNF deployment readiness, onboarding support, and automation using tools like Terraform and Ansible. Familiarity with cloud security best practice and compliance.
* Experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration with ECS or EKS.
* Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).

title: Design & Planning Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Design & Planning Specialist designs, analyses, plans, and modifies network components supporting customer communication implementation activities. Develops and evaluates network performance criteria and measurement methods. Prepares the analysis of the short or long-term capacity needs for switching, routing transmission, and signalling. Conducts network architecture design, feasibility, and cost studies. Develops alternative routing scenarios and changes in required sequence of network activities. Conducts economic and population growth studies to determine impact on network capacity and development plan projections. Performs the end-to-end design activities (including surveys, design itself, and as-built) required for a physical network deployment.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Lead the end-to-end integration of complex software solutions across Nokia Labs, Customer Labs, and Production environments.
* Contribute to Solution Description (SD), customer requirements, architecture documentation, and develop Low-Level Design (LLD) documents from architecture and HLDs.
* Design, develop, and execute Methods of Procedure (MOPs) to ensure consistent, "first-time-right" deployments, migrations, and software onboarding (CNFs) on Cloud Native platforms.
* Develop and execute Acceptance Test Plans (ATPs), support customer acceptance activities, and perform vertical and horizontal integration.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, support First Office Application (FOA) activities, provide timely resolutions, and ensure successful production deployments.
* Build trusted technical advisory relationships with customer engineering stakeholders while working autonomously and applying best practices to improve products, services, and delivery outcomes.
* Act as a technical leader, mentor, and advisor by guiding team members, contributing to task forces, and leading complex technical initiatives and migration activities.

**Key Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* 4+ years of telecom experience with Core Network deployment, integration, and validation (mandatory).
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Native technologies, DevOps, CI/CD, and hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm (mandatory).
* Experience with Linux, basic shell scripting, TCP/IP networking, TLS certificates, Kubernetes firewall configuration, and editing YAML/JSON configuration files.
* Good understanding of telecom protocols and interfaces, including IPv4/IPv6, HTTP/HTTPS, REST, SOAP, LDAP, SPML, Diameter, XML, and YAML/JSON.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, including Wireshark log analysis, IP connectivity debugging, and network issue resolution.
* Experience executing functional, regression, sanity, load, and performance testing, including simulator/emulator setup and environment configuration.
* Experience preparing, adapting, and executing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) across lab, pre-production, and customer production environments.
* Highly desirable experience with automation, Python, shell scripting, Apache JMeter, Ansible, Chef, Kibana, SoapUI, Harbor Registry, MULTUS, and DANM Networks.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in global, cross-functional teams.

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As part of the Global engineering Team, this position will be responsible for engineering and consulting services and solutions to Global team across protection, control, and automation applications, with special focus on power industry applications such as microgrid control systems, remedial action schemes, renewable integration, substation automation, and digital substations. The successful candidate should have proven project experience and an electrical an engineering background.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design and delivery of complex protection solutions for generation, transmission, distribution systems for electrical utilities and industrial clients.
* Participate in the design and development of microgrid solutions including power flow optimization and dispatching algorithms.
* Perform engineering studies and analyses such as: short circuit, load flow, ground grid, arc-flash protective device coordination, etc.
* Performing power system studies and calculations, including, and not limited to CT/VT adequacy checks and relay settings (project-related engineering activity).
* Create relay setting files to include programming of Protection and Control Elements, Control Logic and Communications settings for GE and third-party protective relays.
* Test customized Protection and Control solutions both in house and at customer installations
* Ability to model and conduct power system simulations using RTDS simulator or equivalent.
* Provide factory acceptance test plans and testing services to validate protection designs for customer witnessing.
* Site acceptance test planning and field support up to and including commissioning of new applications.
* Assist software tool development to automate the engineering process internally and externally with key utility partners.
* Participate in project meetings with project managers and customers on technical discussions.
* May require travel up to 20 - 40% of the time depending on projects

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelors (Masters or higher is preferred) in Electrical or Power Systems Engineering with very good understanding of power system applications and analysis.
* Minimum (5) years of experience in protection, control, and automation applications.
* Excellent understanding of power systems phenomena in transmission & distribution systems.
* Understanding of power system protection relays, automation, control and communication protocols.
* Ethical and professional business manner in interaction with team members and customers.
* Customer focused; open to accept new challenges and share ideas.
* Technical skills to execute projects and write SOW proposals.
* Strong learning skills.
* Willingness and ability to work across time zones to support global customers if required

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experienced in study software and power system tools such as Mathcad, MATLAB, PSSE, PSCAD, Power Factory, ASPEN, CAPE for automating the power system study process.
* Understand of communication system protocols and architectures in electric power industry (DNP3, MODBUS, IEC61850, OpenFMB, etc.).
* Experience with RTDS or Opal Simulation Platforms.
* Flexibility to work in a multi-customer environment and to adapt to requests/comments made in the course of execution.
* Experience with transmission, distribution, and smart grid standards;
* Strong communication skills including technical writing and presentations.
* Knowledge or field experience with system commissioning and testing.
* Experience with advanced automation solutions such as microgrids and remedial action schemes.
* Experience with IEC 61131-3 PLC Programming Languages.
* Project Management experience

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Solution Owner, EDA
description:

The Solution Owner, EDA will play a crucial role in our FIT ITIS DO C&BA HW Engineering department. They will be accountable for the installation, maintenance, and compatibility testing of EDA tools. title: Specialist NPO
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Performance Optimization (NPO) Specialist, you will monitor and analyze network performance, identify and diagnose root causes of issues, and implement optimization actions such as QoS adjustments, parameter tuning, and software upgrades to ensure continuous performance.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead and serve as the primary contact for specific technical domains and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), managing project deliverables independently.
* Engage with customers as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), offering technical guidance and insights.
* Optimize network performance through traffic, capacity, and neighbor management to enhance Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and end\-user experience.
* Identify and recommend new feature rollouts and conduct carrier aggregation analysis for multi\-carrier networks.
* Perform analysis and optimization for benchmarking activities (e.g., Umlaut/P3, regulatory drive tests) and validate/optimize Network Performance Optimization (NPO) tools.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., CM, PM, FM, OMS) to resolve issues and manage customer interactions regarding Service Level Agreement (SLA) KPIs, regulatory compliance, and benchmarking reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You Have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in or related field with experience in Network Performance Optimization.
* Expertise in radio optimization for the latest SW/HW Release of Nokia 5G/4G and/or Samsung/Huawei 5G /4G Network.
* Experience in OEM\-specific tools and products, including Nokia SRAN BTS, NetAct, and/or Samsung LSMR, USM.
* Experience in at least two RATs (5G \& 4G) per OEM.
* End\-to\-end correlation across Radio, Access, IP, Transport, and Core domains.to improve Customer Experience, Service KPIs.
* Experience in spectrum refarming, 2G/3G sunset strategies, and post\-optimization activities. Proficiency in data visualization \& reporting tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Pivot Tables, Power BI).
* Experience in Radio Network Consolidation, ORAN, Cloud RAN, VRAN, Enterprise Networks, Private 5G, Massive MIMO, Network Slicing, MEC, and IoT Connectivity.

* Experience in network deployment, backhaul delivery, or telecom operations

title: Fault Management L2 Engineer 3
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Fault Management Engineer in Managed Services (MSE), you are responsible for keeping the network running and proposing/conducting network upgrades based on business requirements. Covers technical management and operation of agreed components of IT and telecommunications services provided to end users of Nokia customers, within contracts agreed with those customers.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

title: Solution Services Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Services Domain Architect to join our team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, which includes integrating various cloud platforms and applications. The architect will design and implement end\-to\-end test setups that mimic customer architectures, ensuring seamless vertical and horizontal integration. Additionally, they will lead the execution of functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, developing automated test scripts to streamline the testing process.

* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.

 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Engineer - Controls Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Engineer is responsible to provide solution, execute basic \& detailed design engineering for SA projects up to 765kV as per customer specification and internal standards. Initiate technical discussion and secure customer approval on Engineering documents; Deliver quality on\-time document for procurement, manufacturing, testing, site erection and commissioning.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
**Function**
* Study of Technical Specification, Contract/customer requirements, technical inputs
* Prepare the DCS Design Concept, Design strategy, List of deliverables, finalise bill of quantity/ budget man\-days, identify risk \& mitigation plan based on the products \& tender documents.
* Finalize IEDs, Bought\-on\-Job materials and raise purchase requisition to meet the delivery schedule.
* Preparation \& Validation of Technical Design, Engineering Documents / Drawings, Sub Station IO List.
* Visit/Attend Customer discussions to secure document approvals, prepare compliance to customer observation/comments as required.
* Integration of IEDs with various protocols, Configure, Test/Validate, trouble shoot the SAS database.
* Release technical design drawings, documents and database to Internal Test team for inspection.
* Co\-ordinate with stakeholders like FAT team for internal validation and participate in customer FAT as required.
* Provide support to the service team to resolve technical issues and snag lists.
* Co\-ordinate with Product Line for closure of technical issues in design, FAT \& SAS commission.
* Share Return of Experience across the team \& implement the applicable RoEs in design phase.
* Manage technical interface with sub suppliers \& partners.
* Technical support for project at ITO stage.
* Travel for customer visit / site if required.
* Adhere to all safe working procedures in accordance with EHS instructions.


**Time schedule \& On Time delivery**
* Participate with Engineering Leader / Project Manager and finalize deliverables and project plan
* Manage design time spent on relevant activities
* Ensure on\-time delivery of Quality design deliverables
* On weekly basis provide Team lead and /or PM with project reviews


**Project strategy, risk management, Process \& Tools**
* Follow project strategy \& highlight scope or design changes (data for claims, VO)
* Propose quality \& cost\-effective solutions.
* Track, manage \& mitigate identified or potential deviations / risks.
* Comply with GE Quality Procedures, work instructions and process for seamless project execution.
* Anticipate and mitigate delivery issues and recommend change


**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical \& Electronics or Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Relevant field experience of 4 to 8 years in SAS Engineering/Commissioning.
* Independent to handle the project Engineering, Customer discussion/approvals, Test, validate \& troubleshoot the SAS products/system.
* Broad knowledge on Substation Automation System Engineering, Communication architecture, Industrial protocols like IEC 61850, Modbus, T104, Network concepts (Layer\-2 \&3\), Process bus based Digital Substation, Automation and control system standards and regulatory compliance.
* Experience to integrate IEDs of multiple vendors like Hitachi, Siemens, SE, SEL; DCS/Network Troubleshoot tools.
* Expertise in cybersecurity best practices and security hardening techniques for industrial control systems.
* Basic Knowledge on Engineering process, Protection, Commissioning of SAS systems, India region utility/industry practices and standards.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and responsive skills
* Ability to work independent \& Problem\-solving skills
* Proficient to Work with cross function teams.
* Collaboration and Teamwork; Innovation; Convince and Influence
